events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, aged 25.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, we lost one of hip-hop's most profound voices. Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year, left an indelible mark on music and culture in his short 25 years.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago today, we lost a true pioneer. Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84, reshaped rock music forever with his innovative guitar work. His sound continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover? Instantly recognisable. The music? Absolutely timeless. Still got it on vinyl?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Rock Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' legend continues to deliver that unmistakable voice and attitude. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: LG's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still rock 'n' rolling. We're raising a glass to the main man today.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago today, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with a powerful message of peace and unity. Truly iconic.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago today, the very first iPod arrived and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Today we celebrate 007's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music legend John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His songs continue to inspire and challenge us.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is simply unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away, aged 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy with Queen remain absolutely legendary. He would have been 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' hit the shelves, marking a pivotal moment in pop music. It's still a masterclass in songwriting. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, music legend John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City, aged 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent with the tragic loss of John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. He would have been 86 this year.
